# GS1 Inspired Product Demonstration

> A demonstration catalogue of four GTIN-identified products, with
> Schema.org JSON-LD, source provenance, and product credentials.

This is a demonstration site, not a shop or an official GS1 registry.
Prices, availability, shipping and return terms are synthetic test data.
There is no checkout.

The Dal Giardino risotto is fictional. The Tesco jam identity match
remains provisional. Preserve evidence qualifications when using records.
Statements labelled TEST ONLY are invented examples, not real ingredient
lists or allergen declarations. Unknown allergens do not mean absent allergens.

Product records and issuer credentials are separate resources.
Credential publication alone does not establish verification, issuer trust,
or the factual accuracy of product claims.

This index describes available content; it does not grant crawling,
training or reuse permissions. Consult robots.txt for crawler directives.

## Start here

- [Product catalogue](https://gs1-product.perdl.com/): Browse all four demonstration products.
- [About the records](https://gs1-product.perdl.com/about/): Purpose, scope and limitations.
- [Provenance](https://gs1-product.perdl.com/provenance.json): Identity confidence, sources, synthetic fields and food-composition evidence.

## Products

- [Dal Giardino Risotto Rice with Mushrooms 411g](https://gs1-product.perdl.com/products/09506000134352/): Fictional GS1 demonstration product.
- [Apple iPhone 17 256GB White](https://gs1-product.perdl.com/products/00195950643718/): Smartphone record; food ingredients and allergens are not applicable.
- [Sierra Nevada Torpedo Extra IPA](https://gs1-product.perdl.com/products/00083783000085/): Single 12 US fl oz bottle; food-composition evidence is scoped to the product family.
- [Tesco Raspberry Jam 454g](https://gs1-product.perdl.com/products/05000119096753/): Provisional identity match; ingredient evidence is not exact-GTIN verified.

## Structured product data

- [Combined product records](https://gs1-product.perdl.com/products.jsonld): Schema.org JSON-LD for all four products.
- [Risotto JSON-LD](https://gs1-product.perdl.com/products/09506000134352/product.jsonld): Individual product record.
- [iPhone JSON-LD](https://gs1-product.perdl.com/products/00195950643718/product.jsonld): Individual product record.
- [Beer JSON-LD](https://gs1-product.perdl.com/products/00083783000085/product.jsonld): Individual product record.
- [Jam JSON-LD](https://gs1-product.perdl.com/products/05000119096753/product.jsonld): Individual product record.

## Issuer and credentials

- [Issuer metadata](https://gs1-product.perdl.com/.well-known/holon-issuer.json): Issuer identity, supported credential mechanisms and declared trust policy.
- [Issuer DID document](https://gs1-product.perdl.com/.well-known/did.json): Verification methods and public keys.
- [Product credential schema](https://gs1-product.perdl.com/schemas/product-holon-v1.json): Structure of product credentials.
- [Example product credential](https://gs1-product.perdl.com/products/09506000134352/product.vc.json): Risotto credential; inspect its proof, validity and credentialStatus references.

- [Test store](https://gs1-product.perdl.com/store/): Synthetic seller information.
